map.按蔬菜类别与当地无霜期安排：叶菜（白菜/菠菜）春秋播、生长期 30-60 天；果: Plan by vegetable category and the local frost-free period: leafy greens (Chinese cabbage / spinach) are sown in spring and autumn with a 30-60 day growing period; fruiting crops (tomato / cucumber) are transplanted in late spring and prefer warmth; root crops (radish / carrot) are sown in summer and autumn and must not be transplanted.
map.温带：番茄 3 月育苗、终霜后（约 4 下-5 上）移栽，生长期约 110 天，: Temperate regions: tomato sown in March and transplanted after the last frost (around early April to early May), growing about 110 days and harvested July-September; spinach sown twice, in March and August, best below 20-25℃; radish sown in August and harvested September-October. In subtropical regions the same crop is about 30 days earlier.
map.错过播期怎么办？: What if I miss the sowing window?
map.选生长期短的速生品种（鸡毛菜 20 天、樱桃萝卜 30 天），或用大棚/阳台控温: Choose fast varieties with short growing periods (choy sum 20 days, cherry radish 30 days), or use a greenhouse/balcony with temperature control to extend the season.
map.为什么根菜不能移栽？: Why can't root crops be transplanted?
map.主根受损后易分叉畸形，应直播；果菜与部分叶菜可育苗后带土移栽减伤。: The taproot is easily damaged and forks or deforms, so they should be sown directly; fruiting crops and some leafy greens can be raised first and transplanted with their root ball to reduce damage.
